r2SourceEvidence.review_note: Skara Brae is a prehistoric Neolithic Orkney settlement, not a Roman site; blank hint makes no substitute claim. Wikipedia gives approximately 3180–2500 BCE, while Historic Environment Scotland gives village life ending about 2500 BCE. The inherited -4000 to 641 slot and town rank are unchanged and unverified, not proof of continuous occupation. The loader may use other hints or saved data.
